From: Lucinda Mayer <lucinda.mayer@brighthealth.com>

Cc: Ben Rossi <ben.rossi@brighthealth.com>
Date: 2025-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: residency scope + PrivateLink details for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Grace,

We're working through BrightHealth's SIG/CAIQ review and need to lock a few items on Redwood's hosting and private-connect posture before we can sign off. High level asks:

- Region coverage: confirmation of which physical regions you serve production workloads from (US/EU/APAC) and whether data egress can be restricted to a selected region.
- Private deployment controls: an inventory of PrivateLink/privatelink-style endpoints, IP ranges, and any peering/egress fallback behavior.
- Key management: where are customer KMS keys stored for Dedicated/Private deployments (region affinity)?
- Evidence artifacts: a short declaration letter we can include in our SIG packet, and any self-assessment template you can share to speed review.

Can you share a short package and an estimate for when we can get the PrivateLink inventory? If you have a quick self-assessment template we can fill, that would help accelerate the SOC/CAIQ intake.

Thanks,
Lucinda

Security Operations
BrightHealth

Attachments: none
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Lucinda Mayer <lucinda.mayer@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-31T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: residency scope + PrivateLink details for SIG/CAIQ

Hi Lucinda — thanks for the clear list. See the initial package attached and a suggested next step: complete the network_self-assessment_template and we'll run a short ops workshop to walk the topology. Summary below and attachments are at the bottom.

Summary (short):
- Regions: Redwood operates production nodes in US (us-west-2, us-east-1), EU (eu-west-1), and APAC (ap-southeast-1). Customers may elect a single-region residency configuration for Private/Dedicated; hosted API customers default to regional routing with optional geo-pin.
- Data egress: Private/Dedicated deployments can be configured to block cross-region egress; hosted API has regional routing with documented fallbacks (we will include the fallback policy in the packet).
- PrivateLink inventory: attached (privatelink_inventory_v1.xlsx) — this is a current export of endpoint names, service IDs, advertised CIDRs, and region affinity. Note: we periodically roll our peering endpoints; we will timestamp deliveries and provide a delta export on request.
- KMS: Customer-managed keys (Bring-Your-Own-Key) are supported in Dedicated/Private via KMS integration. KMS key material is stored in the region selected by the customer (we provide examples for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault in the packet).

Next steps:
1) Please fill the network_self-assessment_template.docx with your preferred region(s) and any required CIDR allowlists.
2) Book a 30-minute ops walkthrough (I copied Marissa and Karthik to coordinate).
3) We'll provide an updated privatelink_inventory export and a short declaration letter you can use in your SIG/CAIQ submission.

Attachments included: geo_coverage_declaration_v1.pdf, privatelink_inventory_v1.xlsx, network_self-assessment_template.docx

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if useful.

—Grace
